purpose: Whole-board load and fit experiment; no real robot autonomy validation
board: Orange Pi Zero 3W / Allwinner A733 / 6 GB
cooler: Official cooler fitted for these measurements
active_inputs: Real camera image and VIO. Synthetic LiDAR and mock/in-memory actuator buses.
failures: VIO path drifted and did not return to start
Severe coordinate divergence on a subsequent restart
Camera calibration query returned calib.yaml not found
Image stream resumed once with VIO OFF; automatic restart is not implemented
interpretation: Calibration, synchronization, initialization and firmware need investigation. Missing saved calibration is not a proven sole cause. CPU/NPU compute fit was demonstrated; metric camera accuracy and autonomous collection were not.
